exposure: Timing of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis and treatment initiation (early-pregnancy using broad IADPSG criteria vs. mid-pregnancy using standard IADPSG criteria)
cohort: The study participants were women treated for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), divided into an early-onset GDM group (n=528) and a mid-term-onset GDM group (n=147).
finding: The study found no evidence for the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions initiated after GDM diagnosis in early pregnancy based on the IADPSG criteria, compared with interventions after a mid-pregnancy GDM diagnosis.
mod_finding: No significant between-group difference was observed in the frequency of cesarean delivery.
